title: 第36章 送嫂子去上学
content_zh:
第36章 送嫂子去上学-《赶山1957：二斤猪肉换个媳妇》

上一章

存书签

下一章

“乃香姐，那你准备怎么谢我？”李青山望着眼前的小奶娘，开口问道。

“我……！”

王乃香顿时有些不知所措，自己怎么感谢？

自己什么都没有，怎么感谢？

望着眼前十里八村都算是俊朗的后生，王乃香一咬牙，一闭眼，一踮脚……！

李青山顿时感觉一阵香风袭来。

嘴上落下一片温柔和香甜。

一阵微风吹过，院外树叶哗哗作响，蝉鸣响透了整个夏日，李青山感受着一抹温柔。

二人四目相对。

说不清，道不明的情愫在其中掺杂着……！

“青山，乃香，在不在？”

就在这时。

保健站外传来嫂子柳桂香的声音，李青山和王乃香连忙分开。

“嫂子，你咋来了？”

李青山走到门口，望着抱着被褥的嫂子柳桂香问道。

“你把乃香妹子安排到保健站暂住的事情，我和娘都知道了，娘说乃香妹子一个人在这里住恐怕不安全，特意让我也搬过来陪着，娘正在家里做饭，等到晚上的时候，娘也一起过来。”

柳桂香说完，目光朝着王乃香望了过去，在看到王乃香脸上升起的一抹红晕，以及想到李青山也是从房间内走出来的画面后，心中多少明白了一些什么，开口道：“乃香妹子，姐姐搬过来陪你两天，不会挑毛病吧？”

“桂香姐，我感谢你们还来不及呢！”

王乃香看到柳桂香后，心中有了底，要是晚上让自己一个人在这里住，还真是有些害怕。

除了害怕村子里单身汉之外。

最重要的，还是赵贵那一家子，谁知道他们能干出什么事情来。

“嫂子，刚好你也来了，有件事情我得跟你们说一下！”

“乡里的农村业余高小班即将开班了，今年夏天和冬天的挂锄期一共两次，夏天的规模稍微小一些，所以咱们得主动去报名，也不要什么费用，就自备一些笔记本，铅笔，课本，干粮，煤油灯，蜡烛这些东西。”

李青山开口吩咐道。

"Sister Naixiang, how are you going to thank me?" Li Qingshan looked at the nanny in front of him and asked.

"I...!"

Wang Naixiang was suddenly at a loss. How could she thank him?

How can I be grateful when I have nothing?

Looking at the handsome young men in the eight villages in front of her, Wang Naixiang gritted her teeth, closed her eyes, and stood on tiptoe...!

Li Qingshan suddenly felt a fragrant breeze coming over him.

A soft and sweet taste falls on the mouth.

A breeze blew by, the leaves outside the courtyard rustled, and the chirping of cicadas filled the entire summer. Li Qingshan felt a touch of tenderness.

The two looked at each other.

Unexplainable, unknown emotions are mixed in it...!

"Qingshan, Naixiang, are you here?"

Just then.

The voice of his sister-in-law Liu Guixiang came from outside the health center, and Li Qingshan and Wang Naixiang quickly separated.

"Sister-in-law, why are you here?"

Li Qingshan walked to the door and asked his sister-in-law Liu Guixiang holding the quilt.

"Both my mother and I knew that you arranged for Miss Noxiang to stay at the health station temporarily. Mom said that it would be unsafe for Miss Noxiang to live here alone, so she specifically asked me to move here to accompany her. Mom is cooking at home, and she will come with her in the evening."

After Liu Guixiang finished speaking, she looked towards Wang Naixiang. After seeing a blush rising on Wang Naixiang's face and thinking of Li Qingshan walking out of the room, she understood something in her heart and said, "Sister Naixiang, sister moved here to stay with you for two days, won't you find fault?"

"Sister Guixiang, it's not too late for me to thank you!"

After Wang Naixiang saw Liu Guixiang, she felt confident that she would be a little scared if she was allowed to live here alone at night.

Except for the fear of the single men in the village.

The most important thing is Zhao Gui's family. Who knows what they can do.

"Sister-in-law, you just happened to be here too. I have to tell you something!"

"The rural amateur high school class in the township is about to start. There will be two hoeing periods this summer and winter. The scale in summer is slightly smaller, so we have to take the initiative to sign up. It doesn't cost anything. We just need to bring some notebooks, pencils, textbooks, dry food, kerosene lamps, candles and other things."

Li Qingshan opened his mouth and gave instructions.
